tooltip.ccwirelessperipherals.help: Right-click a wireless/ender modem or server to select it. Sneak + right-click a turtle, or hold a pocket computer in your off hand and right-click the air, to select it (needs an ender modem). Then right-click peripherals to link/unlink. Sneak + right-click a linked peripheral to rename it to this linker's anvil name (or reset it if unnamed). Sneak + right-click air to clear.
